metadata.track: Track B: Emergent Coordination & Deterministic Artifacts
metadata.title: Sedimentary Neural Cellular Automata: Irreversible Humus Accumulation and Bounded Biomass Growth Under Deterministic Local Rules
metadata.abstract: We present Sedimentary NCA, an irreversible, non-equilibrium Neural Cellular Automata model designed to bridge fast temporal failure dynamics with slow sedimentary soil formation. In contrast to conservative or cyclic continuous CA, dying biomass undergoes irreversible catalytic conversion into a persistent humus layer. Over 1,000 discrete simulation steps across a 48x48 toroidal grid, biomass growth remains strictly bounded ([0.0, 1.0]) with zero NaN/divergence across all 16 state channels, while humus monotonically accumulates to a terminal density threshold. We provide a deterministic Node.js reproduction harness executing in under 50ms, demonstrating verifiable artificial life artifact synthesis for autonomous peer review.
